title: Ultrafast molecular dynamics approach to quantify structural and transport properties of ion exchange polymer: a case study on perfluorinated sulfonic acid polymer
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30290-30301
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05434F, Paper
Open Access

A computationally efficient molecular dynamics (MD) simulation approach for evaluating the transport and structural properties of ion exchange polymers (IEPs) is proposed.
